title: A travel request, explained through memory
narration: Follow a travel request through Ironweb's live memory dashboard and Voyara.

title: Memory graph · explore the three tiers
narration: The graph connects hot context, context cards, and durable evidence. Search, select, zoom, and inspect each memory.

title: Inspector · values, history and sources
narration: The inspector exposes values, history, and source links. Replay selects an observed context while the graph stays current.

title: Agent wiring · roles and shared memory
narration: Nine actors are registered. This planning route uses seven specialists plus the memory orchestrator.

title: Activity · inspect each observed event
narration: Activity separates each actor's work. Select an event to inspect what actually happened.

title: Architecture · hot context, cards, evidence
narration: Three tiers connect bounded instructions and traveler facts, task cards, and durable evidence.

title: Context X-ray · exact input and provenance
narration: Context X-ray shows each agent's captured input, allocation, supported fields, and the claims behind them.

title: Cache · measured reuse and capacity
narration: Cache shows measured reuse, payload bytes, and entry limits.

title: Provider · recorded model usage
narration: Provider shows recorded requests and reported model token usage.

title: Hardware · measured and unavailable values
narration: Hardware distinguishes observed memory from unavailable GPU utilization.

title: Latency · inspect an actual measurement
narration: Latency points expose measured context assembly and agent work.

title: Source inspection · stores, vectors and receipts
narration: Inspect live databases, Qdrant vectors, receipts, and masked provider identity.

title: Replay, filters, shortcuts and drawers
narration: Replay, filters, keyboard shortcuts, and responsive drawers complete the controls.

title: Voyara · from discovery to a trip request
narration: Voyara turns these capabilities into a travel experience, from destination discovery to a personal trip planner.

title: Request · Kerala, 2 travelers, 1–3 December
narration: We request Kerala for two travelers, from December first to third, with a relaxed pace and a two hundred thousand rupee budget.

title: Live request · website and dashboard together
narration: The website waits while the dashboard shows the same run. The orchestrator assembles context, specialists research destinations, stays, food, and experiences, then the itinerary and budget agents finish. These are observed events and real model calls. Waiting is accelerated in this edit.

title: Result · seven completed specialists
narration: Seven specialists completed. Voyara saves the itinerary, indicative costs, and each agent's recorded work for review.

title: Before · budget and its supporting source
narration: Open the budget agent's captured context. Its budget is two hundred thousand rupees, backed by a specific claim and source. Context allocation here uses UTF-eight bytes.

title: Change · INR 200,000 → INR 120,000
narration: Now lower the budget to one hundred twenty thousand rupees. Saving the requirement marks the older plan stale before regeneration starts.

title: Regenerate · agents read the revised context
narration: Create a new outline with the same team. Both views remain synchronized as agents read the revised requirements and validate their results. The prior context stays available as history, while the new run captures the updated budget and evidence.

title: After · new budget, new evidence, current version 2
narration: The budget changed from two hundred thousand to one hundred twenty thousand, with a new claim and source. Version two is current.

title: Visible agents. Traceable context. A current plan.
narration: One request, visible agent work, and traceable context changes.
